question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It is impossible to think of Lady Stranleigh as an __ordinary__ mother.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ordinary"** means something that is normal, common, or usual; it refers to something that is not special or exceptional. (सामान्य)

 
 
• **Example:** He lives an ordinary life, with no extraordinary events or achievements.
 
 
 
• **"Usual"** means something that is commonly occurring, expected, or typical; it implies regularity and consistency. (सामान्य)
 
 
• **Example:** She followed her usual routine of jogging in the morning and reading in the evening.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of "ordinary" in this context is **"Usual"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unlucky** (अभागा): Refers to someone or something that experiences misfortune or bad luck.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt unlucky when he lost his wallet the same day he missed his bus.
 
 
 
• **Strange** (अजीब): Refers to something unusual, odd, or peculiar.
 
 
• **Example:** The strange noise coming from the basement made everyone uneasy.
 
 
 
• **Blessed** (धन्य): Refers to someone who is fortunate or enjoys divine favor.
 
 
• **Example:** They felt blessed to have a loving family and supportive friends.
